english.note: Use this for the amount or portion of a substance, especially when discussing how much to add, use, or serve.

exampleSentences.english: The amount of salt you add should be a little less.
exampleSentences.jyutping: lok6 jim4 ge3 fan6 loeng6 jiu3 siu2 di1

english.note: Use this for the amount or portion of something such as food, liquid, ingredients, or work.

exampleSentences.english: The quantity of soup in this bowl is just right.
exampleSentences.jyutping: ni1 wun2 tong1 ge3 fan6 loeng6 ngaam1 ngaam1 hou2

english.note: Use this when “measure” means the amount or portion of something dealt out, rather than the vessel itself.

exampleSentences.english: The measure of soup in this bowl is just right.
exampleSentences.jyutping: ni1 wun2 tong1 ge3 fan6 loeng6 ngaam1 ngaam1 hou2
